p: day on which those designated to perish in the wilderness stopped … As the Master says: … As long as those designated to perish … wilderness had not stopped

day on which those designated to perish in the wilderness stopped dying, as the entire generation that had left Egypt had died due to the sin of the spies (Numbers 14:29–30). As the Master says: As long as those designated to perish in the wilderness had not stopped
